title: Contract Interface Semantic Versioning
description: Schema defining semantic versioning discipline for Stellar Uzima Soroban contract interfaces and SDK compatibility.

version.description: SemVer 2.0.0 version of the interface registry itself.

contracts.description: Map of contract name → version metadata.

major.description: Breaking changes to public interface (function signatures, error variants, event topics).

minor.description: Backward-compatible new functionality (new public functions, new error codes).

sdk_compatibility.description: List of SDK versions confirmed compatible (e.g. soroban-sdk 21.x).

breaking_changes.description: Descriptions of breaking changes introduced at this major version.
